{"type": "response", "content": "## 🚀 Next Steps & Customization Tips

1. **Replace placeholder content** — swap in your name, avatar, bio, and project data in `main.js`
2. **Contact form backend** — wire up [Formspree](https://formspree.io) or [EmailJS](https://emailjs.com) for real email delivery
3. **Deploy** — push to GitHub and enable **GitHub Pages** for free hosting, or use **Netlify** / **Vercel**
4. **SEO** — add `<meta name="description">` and Open Graph tags in `<head>`
5. **Dark/Light toggle** — swap CSS custom properties on a `data-theme` attribute on `<body>`
6. **Upgrade path** — migrate to **React + Vite + Tailwind** for a component-based architecture", "parent_id": "n_1773779996237_6"}

n_1773780058860_27.content:
## 🚀 Next Steps & Customization Tips

1. **Replace placeholder content** — swap in your name, avatar, bio, and project data in `main.js`
2. **Contact form backend** — wire up [Formspree](https://formspree.io) or [EmailJS](https://emailjs.com) for real email delivery
3. **Deploy** — push to GitHub and enable **GitHub Pages** for free hosting, or use **Netlify** / **Vercel**
4. **SEO** — add `<meta name="description">` and Open Graph tags in `<head>`
5. **Dark/Light toggle** — swap CSS custom properties on a `data-theme` attribute on `<body>`
6. **Upgrade path** — migrate to **React + Vite + Tailwind** for a component-based architecture
